skins.name: Fresh Fastener
skins.description: An outfit worn by Amiya while working for a Rhodes Island restaurant. This poofy coat is cold-resistant, and has enough room to hold something penguin-sized.
skins.howToObtain: Certificate Store ( 40 Distinction Certificate or 400 Universal Certificate )

skins.name: Distinguished Visitor
skins.description: The outfit worn by Angelina while she was stationed at the 2nd Final Defense Front. The substance of reality slowly flows between her fingers and her tools.

skins.name: Dreadnaught
skins.description: The attire worn by the elite operator, Beagle, when serving as rearguard during the Great March of Bolívar . This is her final test.
skins.howToObtain: Certificate Store ( 40 Distinction Certificate or 400 Universal Certificate )

skins.name: Homecoming
skins.description: The outfit worn by Operator GreyThroat while participating in a rescue operation for the Infected within the Catastrophe zone of Sugar City. Disregarding protection or camouflage, upon this outfit is etched the will to protect the next person, and save another life.

skins.name: Refined Horrormare
skins.description: The outfit Lappland wore at the Laterano Apostolic Knights ' Funeral Memorial Hall. Collect the debts, and pay the price.

skins.name: Seventh Night's Awakened
skins.code: Bloodline of Combat Collection/Seventh Night's Awakened
skins.description: An outfit worn by Midnight during the promotional video of an annihilation operation. Though it was undeniably effective, everyone agreed that it was a bit over-the-top.

skins.name: Stronghold
skins.description: An outfit worn by Saria during the confrontation between the General Jurisdiction and the Research Branch . Though her surroundings crumbled under the onslaught of Arts colliding, her conviction never wavered, like the land itself.

skins.name: Titleless Code
skins.description: The outfit worn by Executor when tracking important charges for the Laterano Notarial Hall. Though one's identity may change over the years, what the heart desires does not.

notices.title: ANNIVERSARY SIGN-IN EVENT OPEN
lines: DURATION: January 2, 2021, 04:00 (UTC-7) - January 30, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
DETAILS: During the event, players can sign in for 14 days to earn the following rewards.
Day 1: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, New Operator [THRM-EX] * 1
Day 2: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, LMD * 40000
Day 3: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Strategic Battle Record * 20
Day 4: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Optimized Device * 2
Day 5: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Chip Catalyst * 2
Day 6: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Furniture Part * 200
Day 7: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Commemorative Anniversary Wall Lamp * 1
Day 8: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Skill Summary – 2 * 10
Day 9: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Commemorative Anniversary Carpet * 1
Day 10: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, White Horse Kohl * 3
Day 11: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Commemorative Anniversary Bed * 1
Day 12: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Orirock Concentration * 5
Day 13: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Furniture Part * 200
Day 14: Originite Prime * 1, Emergency Sanity Potion * 1, Amiya Outfit [Fresh Fastener]
NOTE:
The Emergency Sanity Potions from this event will be expired at February 5, 2021, 03:59 (UTC-7)
Players can earn all the rewards even without signing in consecutively.
